title: The Vow of Sandpiper Point
author: Vesper Okafor
blurb: Kestrel Galloway, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
